_frame_metadata.purpose: Project structure and module map for AI assistants
_frame_metadata.forAI: Read this file first, then PROJECT_NOTES.md and tasks.json. Update it when modules or architectural boundaries change.

description: Profile-driven Python security audit daemon for OpenClaw and Hermes installations

architecture.notes: Agent-specific parsing and native audits are adapters; normalized findings flow through enrichment, confidence calibration, SQLite persistence, stale resolution, alerts, reports, and exports.

core/agents.description: OpenClaw and Hermes filesystem, process, command, workspace, skill, and native-audit profiles.

core/agentConfig.description: JSON5/YAML parsing and current/legacy schema normalization for auth, sandbox, logging, DM, and MCP settings.

core/advisoryCatalog.description: Loads bundled CVE/GHSA data and refreshes repository advisories from GitHub into a local cache.

core/config.description: Active-profile paths, security rules, patterns, intervals, and feed refresh settings.

core/models.description: Finding, severity, and explicit module health data models.

core/engine.description: Runs monitors and sweeps, refreshes intelligence, enriches/calibrates findings, persists results, resolves stale evidence, and dispatches alerts.

core/db.description: Thread-safe SQLite finding persistence, deduplication, triage, trends, and stale resolution.

core/ioc.description: Built-in and loaded IOC collections, source metadata, match tracking, aging, and live snapshot replacement.

core/iocUpdater.description: ThreatFox/native IOC ingestion with provenance and source-snapshot replacement semantics.

core/profile.description: Detects Docker, current embedded MCP config, skills, config, and gateway relevance.

core/remediate.description: Tightens permissions, delegates config fixes to native schema-aware commands with validated backups, and quarantines malicious skills.

monitors/configWatcher.description: Watches current JSON5/YAML config and reports explicit insecure values and hardcoded secrets.

sweeps/nativeSecurityAudit.description: Executes and normalizes structured OpenClaw or Hermes native audit output.

sweeps/agentVersionCheck.description: Matches installed date-style releases, including composite Hermes output, against generic CVE/GHSA affected ranges.

sweeps/securityScore.description: Weighted 0-140 score across 18 checks using PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN evidence and degraded status when visibility is incomplete.

dataFlow: Successful scan hashes -> stale resolution; degraded/error scans preserve prior evidence

agentSchemaBoundary.issue: Hand-copied product schemas drifted from current OpenClaw JSON5 and Hermes YAML.
agentSchemaBoundary.solution: All agent config parsing/normalization is centralized in agent_config.py and native structured audits are ingested as a separate adapter.

scanCompleteness.issue: Exceptions and denied OS visibility could look like clean scans.
scanCompleteness.solution: ModuleResult carries ok/degraded/skipped/error; unknown checks receive no score credit and only complete scans resolve stale findings.

safeRemediation.issue: Rewriting cloned config keys could corrupt newer agent configurations.
safeRemediation.solution: Config changes are delegated to a product-native fixer with a validated backup and automatic restoration on failure.

conventions.configParsing: Use agent_config.py; do not call json.loads directly on agent configuration.
conventions.visibility: Represent unavailable evidence as ModuleStatus.DEGRADED and UNKNOWN, never PASS.
conventions.remediation: Never write cloned agent schema fields; use a native fixer or require manual action.
